model_output.extraction_notes: The qualifying public debt decomposition table is Table 2 on original physical PDF page 109, printed page 16. It contains the decomposition block beginning with “Public sector debt 1/” and including “Change in public sector debt”, “Identified debt-creating flows”, “Primary deficit”, “Automatic debt dynamics”, “Other identified debt-creating flows”, and “Residual”. Table 1 on original physical PDF page 108 was not selected because it is the external debt sustainability framework. The side charts on the selected pages are visualizations, not the qualifying row-and-column decomposition table.
